connectorApi.protocol: HTTPS GET-only REST API returning JSON (Read-only; never writes to J1)
connectorApi.dataSource: Jenzabar J1 (J1PRD) over site-to-site VPN (Zero cached student data)
connectorApi.hosting: Google Cloud Run, us-central1, project fit-stream-495320-f6
authLayers: Layer 1 (Google Cloud IAM): Authorization: Bearer <Google OIDC identity token> (requires roles/run.invoker)
Layer 2 (Identity Headers): X-User-Id (<J1 ID_NUM>) and X-User-Role (student | advisor | advising_admin; resolved via GET /identity/resolve?email=...)
criticalConventions: Terms use yr (4-digit academic year starting in autumn, so yr=2026&trm=SP is Spring 2027) and trm (FA, SP, SU, IN). Always call GET /terms/resolve?q=... first.
Advisee routes (/advisors/me/advisees/{adviseeId}/...) verify advisor-advisee ownership in J1 and return 404 (not 403) if not owned.
Degree Audit gotcha 1: credits_met covers only credit count; check incomplete_requirements and met ('not_met') before calling a program complete.
Degree Audit gotcha 2: total_credits.met means earned >= needed (124), but if requirements_complete is false, the degree is NOT finished.
Degree Audit gotcha 3: plan.available is always false ('AVStudentPlan not populated at AugU'). Use /students/me/recommend-next-term + /degree-progress instead.
Privacy boundary: Connector API v1.0 does not read BIOGRAPH_MASTER, address/telephone tables, or free-text notes.

instructionsForTomorrow: Mapped directly to Zion Cloud Solutions' Academic Advising Agent Connector API Reference v1.0 (26 GET endpoints over Jenzabar J1 `J1PRD`). Fields natively returned in v1.0 show their exact endpoint and JSON path; campus metrics requiring Phase 2 J1 queries or aggregation are tagged `[Phase 2 J1 Query]`.

SOPHIA.term: SOPHIA Plan (Core General Education — J1 `gen_ed.curriculum: Sophia Core`)
SOPHIA.plainLanguage: Augustana University's general education curriculum required of all undergraduates (45 credits in J1 `audit.gen_ed.hrs_needed`, `aim_label: CORE`).

i18n.zh: SOPHIA 核心通识教育计划（45学分）

DFW Rate.plainLanguage: Percentage of enrolled students who earn a D, earn an F, or withdraw (W). In J1 `degree_rules.min_grade`, major courses require C- or better (`below_c_minus` triggers `retake_to_count`).

i18n.es: Tasa DFW (% de Baja, Reprobación o Retiro; mínimo C- en la especialidad)
i18n.zh: DFW 率（低分/不及格/退课比例；专业课要求 C- 及以上）
i18n.ne: DFW दर (ड्रप / फेल / फिर्ता प्रतिशत; प्रमुख विषयमा कम्तीमा C- आवश्यक)

SAP.plainLanguage: Federal and institutional requirement (`cum_gpa >= 2.0` in J1 `degree_rules.degree.cum_gpa_ok` plus credit completion pace) needed to maintain good standing and financial aid.

i18n.es: Progreso Académico Satisfactorio (Promedio mínimo 2.0 y ritmo de créditos)
i18n.zh: 学业进展合格标准（累计 GPA 至少 2.0 及学分完成进度）
i18n.ne: सन्तोषजनक शैक्षिक प्रगति (न्युनतम २.० GPA र क्रेडिट प्रगति)

Hold.plainLanguage: A restriction on your J1 account (`hold_cde`, `hold_desc`, `hold_type`) that blocks course registration (`blocks_registration: 'H'`) until cleared by the issuing office.

i18n.es: Retención de Matrícula (Bloqueo temporal para inscribir clases en J1)
i18n.zh: 选课限制/冻结（J1 系统中阻止选课的账户限制）
i18n.ne: दर्ता रोक्का (कक्षा दर्ता गर्नुअघि हटाउनुपर्ने अवरोध)
i18n.am: የምዝገባ እገዳ (ኮርስ ከመመዝገብዎ በፊት መፈታት ያለበት)

F-1 Full-Time Load.term: F-1 International Full-Time Enrollment (12+ Credits in `registered_credits`)
F-1 Full-Time Load.plainLanguage: US SEVIS immigration rule requiring F-1 international undergraduate students to stay enrolled in at least 12 credits (`registered_credits >= 12`) each fall/spring semester unless authorized by the International Programs Office (IPO).

i18n.es: Carga Completa F-1 (Mínimo 12 créditos para visa internacional)
i18n.zh: F-1 国际学生全职学分要求（每学期至少 12 学分）
i18n.ne: F-1 अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय पूर्ण-समय क्रेडिट (कम्तीमा १२ क्रेडिट आवश्यक)
i18n.am: የF-1 ዓለም አቀፍ ተማሪ ሙሉ ጊዜ ትምህርት (ቢያንስ 12 ክሬዲት)

Prerequisite Override.plainLanguage: J1's `/students/me/course-eligibility` checks whether prior courses are `met`, `not_met`, or `verify` (`missing[]`). Official permission from a department chair grants a prerequisite or `department_override`.

i18n.es: Elegibilidad y Exención de Prerrequisito (Verificación en J1)
i18n.zh: 课程先修资格检查与豁免许可（J1 资格验证）
i18n.am: የቅድመ-ሁኔታ ይሁንታ (ያለ ቅድመ ኮርስ ለመመዝገብ የሚሰጥ ፈቃድ)

Residency Requirement.plainLanguage: Tracked in J1 `degree_rules.residency` (`major_courses_total`, `at_augustana`, `transfer`, `pct_at_augustana`, `meets_50`): at least 50% of major courses must be taken directly at Augustana University.

i18n.es: Requisito de Residencia en Augustana (Mínimo 50% de cursos de la especialidad en Augustana)
i18n.zh: 本校修读学分要求（至少 50% 专业课须在奥古斯塔纳大学修读）
i18n.ne: संस्थागत रेसिडेन्सी नियम (कम्तीमा ५०% प्रमुख विषय अगस्टानामा पढ्नुपर्ने)

fields.label: J1 Student ID (ID_NUM)
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Jenzabar J1 unique student identifier (`id_num` / `advisee_id`, passed in `X-User-Id` or `/advisors/me/advisees/{adviseeId}`).

fields.label: School / Division
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Augustana School or Division code in J1 course catalog (`school`, `division`).

fields.label: Assigned J1 Advisor & Ownership

fields.label: Earned Credits (of 124) & requirements_complete
fields.plainLanguageDescription: J1 `audit.total_credits.earned` vs `needed` (124). Note: Check `requirements_complete` (not just `total_credits.met`) to confirm degree completion.

fields.label: Registered Term Credits & Count
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Current term enrolled credits (`registered_credits` and `registered_count`; 12+ required for full-time & F-1 status).

fields.label: Active J1 Holds (hold_cde & blocks_registration)
fields.plainLanguageDescription: J1 holds array (`hold_cde`, `hold_desc`, `hold_type`, `display_text`, `blocks_registration: 'H'`, `allow_web_reg`) and caseload `active_holds` count.

fields.label: Major Courses Below C- & Retake Flags
Advisory Prerequisite Eligibility
fields.plainLanguageDescription: J1 advisory prerequisite check returning `status` (`met`, `not_met`, `verify`), `missing[]`, and `already_completed.taken`.

fields.label: International / F-1 12-Credit Guardrail
fields.plainLanguageDescription: Computes live credit load from `/students/me/registration` (`registered_credits >= 12`); note Connector v1.0 does not read `BIOGRAPH_MASTER`.
